## Summary

Which issue, adapter or contract change this is. One per pull request.

## What changes

The files and behaviour, in words.

## Contract impact

`none`, or the schema and vectors changed and why. A contract change is a public-surface change.

## Checks

Each command run and its result, including the certification suite for a touched adapter and any
mutation check.

## Material-decision impact

`none`, `public-surface`, `security-boundary` or `dependency-boundary`, and whether a clean-room
review round follows.

## Sign-off

Every commit carries a Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off that matches its author.
